text:
kai: :rotating_light: seeing 20% 503s from inference-hosted in us-west2 starting ~1946154300. dashboard shows request queueing and no new GPU nodes coming up
infra-bot: ALERT: autoscaler scale-up failed for pool=gpu-pool-uswest2 (reason=provisioner_throttle) at 1946154310
sophia: confirmed, metrics look like scale-up attempted but node provisioning stayed in Pending for >6m. describing nodepool shows 'Insufficient resources' from cloud provider
aj: any recent changes to autoscaler thresholds or cloud quotas?
kai: not from my side. HPA and cluster-autoscaler configs unmodified yesterday. I see a flurry of spot evictions in the region 1946154200-1946154300 in cloud events log
taylor: link to logs: https://console.internal/logs?query=gpu+evict+us-west2 (adding for context)
aj: can you paste the node events?
kai: ```
Events:
  Type     Reason                 Age                From                Message
  ----     ------                 ----               ----                -------
  Warning  FailedCreate           6m (x23 over 7m)   provisioner         Insufficient capacity for instance type: g4dn.xlarge
  Normal   NodeRegistered         5m                 kubelet             Node registered: ip-10-0-5-23
  Warning  KubeletNotReady        4m                 kubelet             Kubelet is not ready: image pull backoff on startup script
```
sophia: interesting — provisioner returned insufficient capacity, then a few nodes registered but kubelet stuck on image pull. could be AMI or registry flakiness
aj: meanwhile traffic is piling up. Can we reroute prod inference traffic to eu-west1 fallback for the spike? runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/traffic-shift
taylor: +1 for traffic shift. note: eu-west1 has spare capacity but higher p99 latency (20% higher). ops ok with temporary cost bump?
kai: we need to avoid timeout cascades. I'll start shift to eu-west1 at 1946154380 using weighted routing (80/20 → 50/50 → 0/100). will follow runbook steps.
infra-bot: ACTION: rolling traffic-shift initiated by kai at 1946154390 — route rule updated (inference.prod): us-west2 weight 60 -> eu-west1 40
oncall-sre: I'm on pager; watching error budget. If eu-west1 SLOs degrade, will revert to canary fallback to dedicated pool
sophia: manual mitigation plan: 1) promote hot-pool (reserved) in us-west2 for critical inference: `kubectl label nodepool gpu-hotpool reserve=true` 2) manually scale inference deployment to 50 replicas: `kubectl scale deploy/inference-worker -n prod --replicas=50` 3) adjust autoscaler cooldown from 300s -> 90s to allow faster re-scale if signals are noisy
aj: to do the promote we need approval from finance for using reserved capacity immediately? that will hit costs. who can approve?
taylor: I'll ping finance in #finance and get verbal ok for 2 hours of burst. :thumbsup:
kai: executing manual scale now (kubectl scale...) at 1946154425
kai: `kubectl get pods -n prod | grep inference-worker` shows new pods stuck in ContainerCreating for ~30s, then some go Running
sophia: I'm patching the nodepool startup script to retry image pulls and raising imagePullPolicy to Always to avoid stale images causing startup failures
aj: autoscaler logs snippet: ```
I0315 19:00:10 autoscaler.go:214] scale-up loop: desired=38 current=22 pending=10 reason=pod_pending
E0315 19:02:41 cloudprovider.go:98] launch attempt failed: Provisioner throttle: quota or capacity exhausted
```
kai: after traffic shift weight 60/40, errors dropped from 20% -> 6% p5m. continuing to move to 30/70 now
oncall-sre: keep me posted. also start a short-lived alert mute in pager for noisy evictions while we stabilize
taylor: finance approved 2h burst, I've added annotation `cost-approved: 2h` on the promotion ticket
sophia: autoscaler config change proposal: lower scaleUpDelay to 60s and reduce stabilizationWindow from 300s to 90s. will open PR and roll to staging after traffic is stable
aj: after nodes came up we got OOM on a few pods — looks like model cache size + single-GPU memory contention. lowering prefetch count helped
kai: status update at 1946154781: traffic now 95% routed to eu-west1, us-west2 error rate down to 1.2%, autoscaler scaled to 48 replicas total, hot-pool promoted, we're tracking costs. follow-ups: PR to autoscaler cooldown tweak, runbook update for spot-eviction pattern, and improve image registry resilience
taylor: thanks all. postmortem owner? assigning to sophia for infra side, aj for autoscaler changes, kai for runbook updates
sophia: will own infra postmortem. I'll start timeline and initial blameless notes
kai: :white_check_mark: closing thread for now, will reopen if any regression
